The plate is a square-ish white plate, about 22 cm across (a side plate to small dinner plate). The scrambled eggs cover roughly 220 px of the 340 px plate width, which is about 14 cm, and about 150 px in depth, which is about 10 cm. That gives a footprint of about 100 cm² at an average height of about 2.5 cm, so roughly 250 cm³. Allowing for air pockets in the loose eggs, I estimate a density of about 0.6 g/cm³, which gives around 150 g. The black specks look like pepper, and the amount is negligible.
